# mintyrasr

[English](#overview) \| [中文](#%E6%A6%82%E8%BF%B0)

## Overview

**mintyrasr** runs GBLUP parameter estimation and cross-validation with
[ASReml-R](https://vsni.co.uk/software/asreml-r) directly on the nested
data built by [mintyr](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyr/) - no input
files have to be exported.

    phenotypes ─► mintyr::cv_scenarios() ─► asr_scenarios() / asr_gblup() ─► varcomp · h2 · rg · rp · PA · accuracy · slope ─► xlsx

- **Four (five) scenarios in one call**: single-trait / two-trait x
  single group / groups combined, plus one trait as a different trait
  per group (`mt_bt`, G x E).
- **Genetic parameters that follow the model**: h2, rg and rp are built
  from the *names* of the variance components, not from fixed `V1`,
  `V2`, … positions, so they stay right when you add random effects
  (`~ ide(id) + litter`) or change structures (`us`, `idh`, `corv`,
  `corh`, `corgh`). The `vc_index` table shows which `V` is which
  component.
- **Correct tests**: LRT of rg = 0 against `idh(trait)` with
  `boundary = FALSE`; optional joint test of all covariances.
- **Three ways to treat variance components in cross-validation**: fixed
  at the full-data estimates (fast), warm-started, or re-estimated per
  fold (no leakage).
- **Per fold**: GEBV reliability `1 - PEV / ((1 + F) Va)`, predictive
  ability `r(y, GEBV)`, accuracy `PA / sqrt(h2)`, slope `b(y ~ GEBV)`.

## Installation

ASReml-R 4 (licensed, from [VSNi](https://vsni.co.uk/)) must be
installed first.

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("tony2015116/mintyrasr")
```

## Example

``` r

library(asreml)
library(mintyr)
library(mintyrasr)

sc <- cv_scenarios(pheno, cols = c("adg", "bf", "fcr"), id = "id",
                   group = "test_herd", v = 5, repeats = 5, seed = 2026,
                   out_type = "df")

res <- asr_scenarios(sc, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, inbreeding = inbreeding,
                     dir = "results")      # st_sp_ginv.xlsx, st_mp_ginv.xlsx, ...
res$mt_sp$param      # h2, rg, rp (+ SE), rg_p, formulas used
res$mt_sp$summary    # PA, accuracy, slope: n, mean, sd, se
```

- [Get
  started](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/articles/mintyrasr.html)
- [Models and genetic
  parameters](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/articles/models.html)
- [Cheatsheet](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/cheatsheet.html)

## 概述

**mintyrasr** 直接在 [mintyr](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyr/)
生成的嵌套数据上，用 ASReml-R 完成 GBLUP
参数估计和交叉验证，无需导出任何输入文件。

- **一次跑完所有场景**：单性状 / 两性状 × 单群体 /
  多群体，以及同一性状在不同群体当作不同性状（`mt_bt`，G×E）。

- **遗传参数跟着模型走**：h2、rg、rp 按方差组分的*名字*自动生成 vpredict
  公式，不再写死 `V1`、`V2`……；
  加随机效应（`~ ide(id) + litter`）或换结构（`us`、`idh`、`corv`、`corh`、`corgh`）都不会算错，`vc_index`
  表列出每个 V 对应的组分。

- **检验正确**：rg = 0 用 `idh(trait)`
  对照、`boundary = FALSE`；可选所有协方差的联合检验。

- **交叉验证中方差组分三种处理**：固定为全数据估计值（快）、以全数据为初值重估、每折完全重估（无信息泄漏）。

- **每折输出**：GEBV 可靠性 `1 - PEV / ((1 + F) Va)`、预测能力
  `r(y, GEBV)`、准确性 `PA / sqrt(h2)`、回归系数 `b(y ~ GEBV)`。

- [入门](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/articles/mintyrasr-zh.html)

- [模型与遗传参数](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/articles/models-zh.html)

- [速查表](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/cheatsheet-zh.html)

# Package index

## GBLUP with ASReml-R

Parameter estimation and cross-validation for one scenario, or for all
scenarios of mintyr::cv_scenarios() in one call.

- [`asr_gblup()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/reference/asr_gblup.md)
  : GBLUP parameter estimation and cross-validation with ASReml-R

- [`asr_scenarios()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/reference/asr_scenarios.md)
  :

  Run several GBLUP scenarios from `cv_scenarios()`

# Articles

### English

- [Get started with
  mintyrasr](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/articles/mintyrasr.md):

  From a phenotype table to variance components, genetic parameters and
  cross-validated accuracy for every GBLUP scenario, directly in
  ASReml-R.

- [Models and genetic
  parameters](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/articles/models.md):

  Random effects, variance structures, how the V numbers of vpredict()
  are found from the component names, tests of correlations, and your
  own formulas.

### 中文

- [mintyrasr
  入门](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/articles/mintyrasr-zh.md):

  从表型表到每个 GBLUP 场景的方差组分、遗传参数和交叉验证准确性，全部在
  ASReml-R 中直接完成。

- [模型与遗传参数](https://tony2015116.github.io/mintyrasr/articles/models-zh.md):

  随机效应、方差结构、如何从方差组分名字确定 vpredict() 的 V
  编号、相关的检验以及自定义公式。
